row: E28 (GLV note §9.26 pre-registration, §9.30 results): GLS psi fold on E19's single-tau_T line. Stage 0 (40 curves), Stage A (10 curves, tau and tau-psi arms on one exact-oracle stream, 640 walks, the registered solve-cost control) and the supplementary control are measurements; Stage A2 (S_model) is a model. Evidence directory research/e28_tau_20261030
status_rule: pass iff (a) every check holds, (b) every headline agrees with its printed figure within half a unit of the last printed digit (exact for counts), and (c) the row has a measured end-to-end index-calculus cost S, which the validation gate needs to show it against a matched rho. E28 meets (a) and (b) and fails (c): its S is Stage A2's model (R x C + R x g + 16 LA), no end-to-end run with the D4 solve was made (no Stage B, by registration). Status is therefore fail for the gate; the measured parts are verified (replay-certificate.json)
gate_refusal: model-only S: no measured end-to-end S exists for E28 (Stage A2 is a model by registration, §9.26; §9.30 labels it so). Validation of the measured parts and of the model's arithmetic does not make the model a measurement.

registered_control_deviation.why_the_registered_control_was_vacuous: 3 uniform targets per curve against decomposition rates of targets_decomposed / residuals: the expected number of decomposable targets in the 30 registered draws was 0.447, so 0 was the likely outcome by design; the registered check was a negative control (30/30 calls returned no decomposition where the oracle had none), not an agreement test
registered_control_deviation.adequacy: Adequate for G2.102's agreement clause: 30 calls on targets the exact oracle decomposes (3 per curve, all 10 curves, families of 2 and 8 decompositions), every one solved and returning exactly the oracle's set, plus the registered 30 as negative controls. Selecting targets by the oracle does not bias an exact-set comparison. Limits: 3 positive calls per curve is a small sample, so it shows agreement on these 30 calls, not in general; the model's C comes from the registered (uniform) calls, as registered, and the decomposable-target calls cost 1.37-1.48·10⁹, slightly more
registered_control_deviation.verdict: disclosed and adequate, with the sample-size caveat

limitations: S is a model (Stage A2): no end-to-end run with the D4 solve exists (no Stage B, by registration). The validation gate cannot show a modelled S as a measured row; this report's status is fail for that reason alone.

The model prices every residual at the median of 3 control calls; E19's measured S is priced at the mean call. On E19's own rows the median-based formula under-prices the measured S (E5), so S_model is optimistic for E28.

The band's native operations for the IC side are E19's Macaulay entries per residual at the same p (borrowed: E28 ran no Macaulay solve on its residuals); the rho side's are the walk's steps. GAE = 97 F_p multiplications.
The comparison with E19 is across different curves at the same p (E19's curves vs E28's GLS twists), as registered.
Operation counts only. The replay ran locally in the validator's 4-vCPU container, not on isolab-eks; no wall time is compared or claimed.
